cues.en: gallon (3.8 L) of fuel, which is 3 to 4 times more efficient than a semi-trailer truck.

cues.zh: 先从车体和车架说起。
cues.en: Let's start with the body and frame.

cues.zh: 大多数现代货运机车都采用罩式结构，中间部分较窄，
cues.en: Most modern freight locomotives are hood units, with a slim middle section

cues.zh: 车体两侧设有走道，因此驾驶员能看清前后两个方向。
cues.en: and walkways on the outside of the body, allowing visibility in both directions.

cues.zh: 机车前端的车体宽度与车身相同，也就是“宽车身驾驶室”。
cues.en: The nose portion is full width or "wide cab".

cues.zh: 它们通常以短鼻端朝前行驶，车身上的“F”字标识代表“前方”。
cues.en: They mostly run short hood forward, as designated by a decal letter "F" for "front".

cues.zh: 金属车体面板可以打开或拆下，方便维护或紧急检修。
cues.en: Metal body panels can be opened or removed for maintenance or emergency access.

cues.zh: 主要部分包括前端鼻部和驾驶室，
cues.en: Main sections are the nose and operator's cab,

cues.zh: 装满电子元件的辅助驾驶室，
cues.en: auxiliary or "aux" cab which is packed with electronic components,

cues.zh: 发动机，
cues.en: the engine,

cues.zh: 以及位于后部、装有各种冷却部件和车载空压机的散热器室。
cues.en: and radiator cab at the rear with various cooling components and the onboard air compressor.

cues.zh: 车体和关键部件由厚钢或钢合金制成的
cues.en: The body and critical components are supported by a thick steel or steel

cues.zh: 底架平台支撑。车头装有排障器，
cues.en: alloy platform called the underframe. A pilot or cowcatcher sits at the front

cues.zh: 用来弹开发生碰撞可能导致机车脱轨或损坏的障碍物。
cues.en: to deflect obstacles that could derail or damage the locomotive.

cues.zh: 上方有一段名为防爬器的悬伸结构，
cues.en: There's an overhang called the anti-climber that

cues.zh: 能防止弹开的物体飞入驾驶室。
cues.en: prevents deflected objects from flying into the cabin.

cues.zh: 两侧隐蔽的防撞柱能在发生事故时进一步保护驾驶室。
cues.en: Concealed collision posts on each side further protect the cab in the event of an accident.

cues.zh: 车头和侧面标有独一无二的编号。
cues.en: There's a unique ID number displayed on the front and sides.

cues.zh: 车体顶部装有一套气笛，
cues.en: A set of air horns sits on top of the body,

cues.zh: 底架上还装有用来发出警铃声的电子扬声器。
cues.en: and there's an electronic speaker attached to the underframe to emit a bell sound.

cues.zh: 车尾附近可以看到一个大型手动手刹轮。
cues.en: A large manual handbrake wheel is visible near the rear.

cues.zh: 车钩 机车可以与其他机车连接，也可以
cues.en: Coupling Locomotives can couple with other locomotives, or

cues.zh: 与车厢连接。车钩有多种类型。我们的机车装的是更复杂的“F型”车钩，
cues.en: train cars. There are various coupler types. Our locomotive has a more complex "Type F" coupler,

cues.zh: 而我们的车厢上则是更简单的E型车钩。例如，F型具有坚固的侧面结构，
cues.en: versus the simpler Type E style on our train car. Type F, for example, has robust side features to

cues.zh: 在事故情况下防止垂直移动，而E型则没有这类保护。
cues.en: prevent vertical movement in accident conditions, where Type E requires no such protections.

cues.zh: 车钩的设计原理是相互碰撞来连接。
cues.en: Couplers are designed to work by bumping into one another.

cues.zh: 它们可以以各种方式连接，例如两个车钩都打开，
cues.en: They'll couple in various arrangements, for example with both couplers open,

cues.zh: 或者一个关闭、一个打开。
cues.en: or one closed and one open.

cues.zh: 钩舌的形状能相互引导，并沿着对侧车钩表面滑动。
cues.en: Knuckles are shaped to guide each other and also ride along the opposite coupler surface.

cues.zh: 它压向钩舌推铁，
cues.en: that presses against the knuckle thrower

cues.zh: 进而推动锁铁。锁铁沿着内部通道滑动，
cues.en: which in turn moves the lock. The lock rides along an internal channel,

cues.zh: 同时也靠在钩舌后部的斜面结构上，
cues.en: and also rests on a sloped feature at the back of the knuckle

cues.zh: 这样当所有部件到达行程末端时，锁铁就会自然滑入锁定位置。
cues.en: so that it naturally slides into locking position as all parts reach the end of their travel.

cues.zh: 要解开车钩，有一个手动操作的杆，叫做提销杆或解钩杆。
cues.en: For uncoupling, there's a manually operated bar called the pin lifter or cut lever.

cues.zh: 转动时，各部件按与连接相反的顺序动作。锁铁向上移动，
cues.en: When rotated, parts operate in a reverse sequence to coupling. The lock rides upwards,

cues.zh: 压动关节推杆，使关节旋转到打开位置。
cues.en: pressing the knuckle thrower which rotates the knuckle into open position.

cues.zh: 车钩连接在牵引装置组件上，这提供了一种
cues.en: The coupler is attached to the draft gear assembly, which provides a kind of

cues.zh: 车厢之间的悬挂。在撞击式连接过程中，
cues.en: suspension between train cars. During impact coupling,

cues.zh: 也称为“缓冲事件”，车钩被向后压向牵引装置，
cues.en: also known as a "buff event", the coupler is forced backwards against the draft gear,

cues.zh: 从而压缩内部一叠橡胶圆盘。
cues.en: which compresses an internal stack of rubbery discs.

cues.zh: 牵引装置的后移被后部的厚金属挡片挡住。
cues.en: The draft gear's rearward travel is stopped by thick metal tabs at the back.

cues.zh: 当车厢彼此拉开时，也称为“拉伸事件”，
cues.en: When train cars pull away from each other, also called a "draft event",

cues.zh: 周围的轭将牵引装置拉向前部的挡块，
cues.en: the surrounding yoke pulls the draft gear against a block at the front,

cues.zh: 使内部圆盘再次压缩，吸收可能有害的力。
cues.en: causing the internal discs to again compress and absorb potentially harmful forces.

cues.zh: 车厢连挂在一起时，软管也会接通，为各节车厢的制动系统供气，
cues.en: When cars are coupled together, a hose is also connected to supply air for individual car brakes,

cues.zh: 同时还会连接一根电缆，供配备电子
cues.en: and a cable for cars equipped with electronic

cues.zh: 制动辅助装置的车厢使用。稍后我们会详细介绍这些系统。
cues.en: brake support devices. More about these systems later.

cues.zh: 多台机车重联时，MU 即“重联”连接器会将机械、
cues.en: When multiple locomotives are coupled, the MU or "multiple unit" connector brings mechanical,

cues.zh: 引擎和电气系统全部交由本务机车控制。
cues.en: engine, and electrical systems under control of the lead locomotive.

cues.zh: 连接器在不用时会插在假插座中。
cues.en: The connector sits in a dummy receptacle when not in use.

cues.zh: 另外还有三根软管用来同步机车之间的制动操作。
cues.en: Three additional hoses synchronize braking operations between locomotives.

cues.zh: 分别是总风缸管、作用管和制动缸管。
cues.en: There's the main reservoir hose, the actuating hose, and the brake cylinder hose.

cues.zh: 发动机是一台 12 缸、双涡轮增压、
cues.en: Engine A 12-cylinder, twin-turbo,

cues.zh: 四冲程柴油机，被称为“原动机”，它是这台机车的动力源。
cues.en: 4-stroke diesel engine, called the “prime mover,” is the power source for this locomotive.

cues.zh: 燃油由安装在底架下方的厚壁油箱供应。这些油箱能
cues.en: Fuel is supplied from reinforced-wall tanks mounted beneath the underframe. These tanks can

cues.zh: 装载 5300 加仑（约 20065 升）燃油。燃油
cues.en: carry 5,300 gallons (20065 L) of fuel. The fuel

cues.zh: 喷射系统的每个气缸列都配有一个油泵，
cues.en: injection system has a pump for each cylinder bank,

cues.zh: 气缸之间采用多层高压油管，专为承受高压而设计。
cues.en: with multi-walled tubing between cylinders designed to handle high pressures.

cues.zh: 为降低噪声、提高效率，单个燃烧循环中最多会进行 8 次不同的燃油喷射
cues.en: To decrease noise levels and increase efficiency, as many as 8 different injections of fuel are

cues.zh: 具体次数由燃油系统中的传感器决定。
cues.en: made during a single combustion cycle, as determined by sensors in the fuel system.

cues.zh: 发动机的辅助部件安装在附近，
cues.en: Engine support components are mounted nearby,

cues.zh: 包括润滑油箱、机油滤清器、燃油滤清器等。
cues.en: including a lube oil tank and oil filters, fuel filters, and more.

cues.zh: 涡轮增压 这台发动机配有
cues.en: Turbocharging This engine has

cues.zh: 两个涡轮增压器，可高效地为发动机提供更多燃烧所需的空气。
cues.en: two turbochargers to efficiently supply the engine with more air for combustion.

cues.zh: 附近还有一个增压空气冷却器，用来冷却涡轮压缩后的空气，再将空气送入发动机，
cues.en: There's a charge air cooler nearby to cool turbo air before it reaches the engine,

cues.zh: 因为冷空气密度更高，更适合用来向发动机输送更多空气。
cues.en: since cold air is more dense and better suited to the goal of pumping more air into the engine.

cues.zh: 增压空气冷却器有两侧，分别对应一个涡轮增压器。
cues.en: The charge air cooler has two sides, one for each turbo.

cues.zh: 这两个涡轮采用一种称为复合顺序增压的配置，
cues.en: These turbos are arranged in what's called a compound-sequential configuration,

cues.zh: 其工作方式如下：在较低转速下，废气
cues.en: which functions as follows. At lower RPMs, exhaust gases

cues.zh: 更容易带动较小的涡轮增压器旋转，其压气机叶轮开始吸入空气。
cues.en: can more easily spin up the smaller turbo, whose compressor wheel begins to take in air.

cues.zh: 空气从侧向进气口进入，流经大涡轮，
cues.en: Air enters through a side port and flows through the large turbo

cues.zh: 然后进入小涡轮。随后在流向发动机进气口的过程中被冷却。
cues.en: before entering the small turbo. It's then cooled on its way to the engine intake.

cues.zh: 此时大涡轮尚未全负荷运转。随着转速和可用排气能量的增加，
cues.en: The large turbo is not yet fully powered. As RPMs and resulting available exhaust energy increase,

cues.zh: 阀门打开，带动大涡轮加速旋转。
cues.en: a valve opens, spinning up the large turbo.

cues.zh: 虽然小涡轮在低转速下更容易被推动，但它的设计同样能承受
cues.en: While the small turbo is easier to rotate at lower RPMs, it's also designed to handle

cues.zh: 更高的整体压力。因此，大号的
cues.en: higher overall pressures. As such, the large,

cues.zh: 低压涡轮现在直接将所有空气输送给较小的高压涡轮，
cues.en: low pressure turbo now directly feeds all of its air to the smaller, high pressure turbo,

cues.zh: 整个系统为发动机提供最大的进气量，从而实现巅峰性能。
cues.en: and the whole system delivers maximum airflow to the engine for peak performance.

cues.zh: 为了大幅减少废气中的某些污染物，
cues.en: To dramatically reduce certain pollutants in exhaust gases,

cues.zh: 这些柴油发动机配备了 EGR，即废气再循环系统。
cues.en: these diesel engines are equipped with an EGR, or exhaust gas recirculation system.

cues.zh: 一个阀门让左侧气缸组的废气进入废气再循环系统，
cues.en: A valve allows exhaust from the left cylinder bank to enter the EGR system,

cues.zh: 废气经过水冷却装置后，再与新鲜进气混合。
cues.en: where it passes through a water cooling unit before being mixed with fresh incoming air.

cues.zh: 让一部分废气重新进入燃烧过程
cues.en: Sending some exhaust gas back through the combustion process

cues.zh: 会降低燃烧效率，但能大幅减少整体废气排放。
cues.en: lowers combustion efficiency in favor of greatly reducing exhaust pollutants overall.

cues.zh: 水冷却
cues.en: Water To save

cues.zh: 为节省成本并避免可能造成危害的防冻液泄漏，多个冷却环节都使用水。
cues.en: costs and avoid potentially hazardous anti-freeze leaks, water is used for various cooling duties.

cues.zh: 一个大型水箱可容纳近400加仑（1500升）水。
cues.en: A large tank holds nearly 400 gallons (1500 L) of water.

cues.zh: 由发动机驱动的水泵为系统提供压力。
cues.en: An engine-driven water pump supplies pressure to the system.

cues.zh: 设备配有多组大型散热器，外部百叶窗可帮助调节气流。
cues.en: There are large banks of radiators with external shutters to help manage airflow.

cues.zh: 水流经内部管道时，一台大型风扇将外部空气抽过散热器。
cues.en: A large fan pulls outside air past these radiators as water courses through internal tubes.

cues.zh: 这些冷却水流经发动机、废气再循环冷却器、涡轮增压器、空气压缩机等部件。
cues.en: This cooling water flows to the engine, EGR cooler, turbochargers, air compressor, and more.

cues.zh: 天气较冷时，冷却水还会流经燃油系统的
cues.en: During colder weather, it also runs through the fuel system

cues.zh: 预热器，在燃烧前加热燃油。
cues.en: pre-heater to warm the fuel before combustion.

cues.zh: 如果机车没有运行，且温度降至 40°
cues.en: If the locomotive is not running and temperatures drop below 40°

cues.zh: 华氏度（4.5°C）以下，自动排水阀就会打开，排出系统中的水，防止结冰。
cues.en: F (4.5° C) automatic water dump valves open, draining the system to prevent freezing.

cues.zh: 电气系统：柴油发动机带动一台
cues.en: Electrical The diesel engine turns

cues.zh: 大型交流发电机，它负责发电，为关键系统供电。
cues.en: a massive alternator, which acts as a generator, supplying electrical power to critical systems.

cues.zh: 交流发电机配有专用冷却风机，进风口设在侧面。
cues.en: The alternator has its own dedicated blower for cooling, with a side air intake.

cues.zh: 发动机不会直接通过机械传动驱动机车。相反，大型电动机
cues.en: The locomotive isn't directly, mechanically driven by the engine. Instead, large electrical motors,

cues.zh: 也就是牵引电机，会安装在每个车轮的车轴上，
cues.en: called traction motors, are connected at each wheel axle,

cues.zh: 为列车提供主要驱动力。
cues.en: and provide the main driving force to move the train.

cues.zh: 这些牵引电动机需要精细的转速控制。简单来说，
cues.en: These traction motors require fine-tuned speed control. Without getting into too much detail,

cues.zh: 与交流电相比，用直流电调节电动机的转速更容易。因此，
cues.en: it's simply easier to regulate variable motor speed with DC current as opposed to AC. As such,

cues.zh: 从交流发电机到牵引电动机之间要经过相当复杂的转换过程。
cues.en: a fairly intricate conversion process takes place from the alternator to the traction motors.

cues.zh: 交流发电机输出的交流电经过机车辅助驾驶室区域的整流器组，
cues.en: AC power from the alternator is converted to DC power as it flows through rectifier banks

cues.zh: 转换成直流电。同一系统中的直流链路会平滑交流发电机输出的不稳定电力，
cues.en: in the auxiliary cab section of the locomotive. A DC link in this same system smooths out any

cues.zh: 并将电力调整到所需的速度或频率。
cues.en: uneven power from the alternator, and adjusts power to the desired speed or frequency.

cues.zh: 随后，电流流经逆变器，转换回交流电，再输送到电动机。
cues.en: Current then flows through inverters which convert it back to AC as it's delivered to the motors.

cues.zh: 新技术让调节交流电变得更可行，这个
cues.en: New technology makes varying AC current more doable, and this

cues.zh: 过程在不久的将来可能会改变。牵引电动机运行时会产生大量
cues.en: process may change in the near future. These traction motors generate a lot of

cues.zh: 热量。专用鼓风系统通过风道和柔性接头，
cues.en: heat during operation. There's a dedicated air blower system

cues.zh: 将冷却空气输送到每台电动机。
cues.en: with ducting and flexible connections to deliver cooling air to each individual

cues.zh: 辅助驾驶室下方设有
cues.en: motor. A

cues.zh: 一组电池。除了像启动柴油发动机这样的常规用途，
cues.en: bank of batteries sits under the aux cab. Apart from expectable battery duties like starting the

cues.zh: 这些电池还可以为机车短距离移动供电，
cues.en: diesel engine, these batteries can also deliver power for moving the locomotive small distances,

cues.zh: 例如在铁路编组场内移动机车，无需启动柴油发动机。
cues.en: for example, around a railyard without having to start the diesel engine.

cues.zh: 转向架：底架
cues.en: Trucks The underframe

cues.zh: 转向架也叫“走行部”，支撑着牵引电机、车轴、车轮和相关部件。
cues.en: rides on trucks or "bogies", which hold traction motors, axles, wheels, and associated components.

cues.zh: 转向架设计的一项重要考量是黏着力，
cues.en: A major consideration in truck design is adhesion,

cues.zh: 也就是让车轮与钢轨保持最大接触，以获得牵引力。
cues.en: or ensuring wheels maintain maximum contact with rails for traction.

cues.zh: 轴箱悬挂通过每根车轴两侧的弹簧来提高黏着力。
cues.en: Primary suspension aids adhesion with springs on both sides of every axle.

cues.zh: 一侧安装一对减振器，就足以应对
cues.en: A pair of dampers on one side are sufficient to handle

cues.zh: 转向架的垂向减振任务。
cues.en: vertical shock absorbing duties for the bogie.

cues.zh: 二系悬挂还包括一组减振器，用于抑制绕垂直轴旋转。
cues.en: Secondary suspension includes a set of dampers for rotation about the vertical axis.

cues.zh: 柔性旁承通过销轴连接到底架，同时允许转向架
cues.en: Flexible side bearers are pinned to the underframe but allow bogies

cues.zh: 在重型机车下方移动。
cues.en: to shift underneath the heavy locomotive.

cues.zh: 里面叠放着一组橡胶块，构成一种坚韧的弹簧。
cues.en: Inside, there's a stack of rubber pieces that make up a kind of tough spring.

cues.zh: 车轴也能略微前后移动。
cues.en: Axles can also move back and forth slightly.

cues.zh: 这配合二系悬挂，能确保转向架和车轮保持最大的轮轨
cues.en: This, with secondary suspension, ensures bogies and wheels maintain maximum rail

cues.zh: 接触，即使在长车体的前后两端不在同一直线上，
cues.en: contact even if the front and back of the long locomotive aren't in alignment,

cues.zh: 或在弯道行驶时也是如此；此时前后转向架及其内部的轮对，
cues.en: or on curved sections of track, where front and back trucks, and axles within the trucks,

cues.zh: 可能需要各自独立调整姿态，以保持与钢轨的良好接触。
cues.en: might need specific, individual orientation to keep proper contact with rails.

cues.zh: 牵引销或牵引拉杆加固了转向架与底架之间的连接。
cues.en: A traction pin or rod solidifies the connection between trucks and the underframe.

cues.zh: 安全钩则用于限制转向架在极限工况下的位移。
cues.en: Safety hooks limit bogie movement at extremes.

cues.zh: 牵引电机通过支架安装，使电机能够随车轴一同运动。
cues.en: The traction motors are attached with bracketry that allows the motor to move with the axle.

cues.zh: 齿轮箱将电机的动力传递给车轴和车轮。
cues.en: A gear set transfers motor power to the axle and wheels.

cues.zh: 转向架还配备了撒砂系统，以便在起动或制动时增加牵引力，
cues.en: The trucks also feature a sand system for increased traction during startup or braking,

cues.zh: 或在车速低于每小时 15 英里（24 公里）时使用。
cues.en: or when traveling at less than 15 mph (24 kmh).

cues.zh: 前后两侧都设有沙箱，配有加沙管，方便加注。
cues.en: There are sand boxes at both sides, front and back, with filler tubes for easy access.

cues.zh: 每个转向架前后都有撒沙喷嘴，为正向或反向行驶提供撒沙。
cues.en: Sand nozzles at the front and back of each bogie provide sand for either forward or reverse travel.

cues.zh: 使用时，喷嘴会向车轮和钢轨喷沙。
cues.en: Nozzles blow sand at the wheels and rail when in use.

cues.zh: 制动能力
cues.en: Braking The ability

cues.zh: 要高效牵引如此惊人的吨位，随之而来的是严峻的技术挑战：
cues.en: to efficiently haul incredible tonnage comes with a serious technical challenge:

cues.zh: 让列车停下来。制动主要有两套系统：动态制动和空气制动。
cues.en: stopping the train. There are two main systems for braking: dynamic and pneumatic.

cues.zh: 先来说空气制动系统，它驱动车轮上的闸瓦。
cues.en: Let's start with the pneumatic or air driven system, which actuates brake shoes at the wheels.

cues.zh: 车载空气压缩机提供压缩空气，储存在侧面的储气罐中。
cues.en: The onboard air compressor supplies compressed air which is stored in side tanks.

cues.zh: 制动系统从这些储气罐中取气。
cues.en: The brake system draws from these reservoirs.

cues.zh: 转向架前后由空气驱动的气缸带动拉杆
cues.en: Air driven cylinders at the front and back of the trucks actuate rods

cues.zh: 和连杆机构，进而驱动闸瓦。一个气缸控制一块闸瓦，
cues.en: and linkages that drive brake shoes. One cylinder manages a single shoe,

cues.zh: 另一个气缸则同时驱动两块联动的闸瓦。
cues.en: while another cylinder drives two linked shoes at once.

cues.zh: 不过，每个车轮依然只配有一个闸瓦。
cues.en: Still, there's only one brake shoe per wheel.

cues.zh: 在机车尾部，有一根制动主管负责输送压缩空气
cues.en: At the rear of the locomotive, there's a brake pipe that delivers compressed air

cues.zh: 给列车上的其他每一节车厢。每节车厢都配有独立的风缸，
cues.en: to every other railcar in the train. Each car has its own air reservoir to

cues.zh: 以确保始终能满足该车厢自身的制动需求。
cues.en: make sure there's always supply for the individual car's braking needs.

cues.zh: 现代机车配备了电空制动（ECP）系统，
cues.en: Modern locomotives have electronically controlled pneumatic or ECP systems,

cues.zh: 通过电子元件实现对制动过程的精准控制。
cues.en: where electronics add precision control to braking procedures.

cues.zh: 该系统的核心大脑安装在驾驶室下方。
cues.en: The brains of the system are mounted underneath the cab.

cues.zh: 每节车厢都配有识别单元和控制器装置。
cues.en: Each car has an identifying unit and controller setup.

cues.zh: 列车尾部还连接了一个列尾装置，用来识别最后一节车厢。
cues.en: There's an end of train device connected to identify the very last car.

cues.zh: 当所有车厢都连接好并由 ECP 系统完成正确排序后，
cues.en: With all cars connected and properly sequenced by the ECP system, more complex braking procedures

cues.zh: 就能执行更复杂的制动操作。例如，制动可以从列车的最后一节车厢
cues.en: can be performed. For example, brakes can be applied progressively from the last car in the

cues.zh: 向前逐级施加，这样车厢之间就不会发生追尾撞击。现在，我们来看看动态制动系统。
cues.en: train forward so cars don't ram into each other. Now, let's look at the dynamic braking system.

cues.zh: 动能制动发生在强大的电力牵引电动机内部。
cues.en: Dynamic braking happens inside the powerful electric traction motors.

cues.zh: 简单来说，电机的铁芯或转子具有一个静止磁场。
cues.en: To put electric motors in basic terms, the core or rotor has a stationary magnetic field.

cues.zh: 它被一组称为定子的密集电线圈所包围。
cues.en: It's surrounded by a dense set of electrical windings called the stator.

cues.zh: 电流流过导电材料时，会在其周围产生磁场
cues.en: Electricity traveling through a conductive material creates a surrounding magnetic

cues.zh: （即电磁感应）。电流通过
cues.en: field (electromagnetism). The flow of electricity through

cues.zh: 绕组时，会带动其磁场旋转，进而推动转子转动。
cues.en: the windings causes its magnetic field to rotate, pushing the rotor in turn.

cues.zh: 由于定子磁场是通过电子方式生成的，
cues.en: Since the stator's magnetic field is electronically generated,

cues.zh: 因此它可以被控制，甚至反向，从而对转子的旋转产生阻力。
cues.en: it can be controlled, and even reversed, adding resistance against the rotor's spin.

cues.zh: 这种额外的阻力本质上将牵引电动机转变成了发电机。
cues.en: This added resistance essentially converts traction motors into electricity generators.

cues.zh: 多余的电能被传输到电阻栅中，
cues.en: The excess energy is passed to grids of resistors

cues.zh: 以极高热量的形式耗散掉制动能量。
cues.en: that bleed off braking energy in the form of intense heat.

cues.zh: 动力制动箱将电阻器隔离在配有冷却风扇的独立风道中。
cues.en: The dynamic brake box isolates resistors into their own ducted channel with cooling fans.

cues.zh: 电阻器甚至能热到发出耀眼的红光。
cues.en: Resistors can get so hot they emit a bright red glow.

cues.zh: 动力制动为列车的制动过程
cues.en: Dynamic braking adds stopping power to the train's

cues.zh: 增添了制动力，且几乎没有额外的活动部件，从而减少了各处的磨损。
cues.en: braking process with few additional moving parts, reducing wear and tear all around.

cues.zh: 这种动力制动过程与再生制动原理类似，
cues.en: This dynamic braking process shares concepts with regenerative braking,

cues.zh: 电动汽车可以利用自身动量回收能量，用于电池充电
cues.en: where electric vehicles can use their momentum to recover energy, for battery recharging,

cues.zh: 等等。未来的货运机车很可能会为动力制动系统
cues.en: and so on. Future freight locomotives may indeed implement such capabilities to the dynamic braking

cues.zh: 引入这种能力，而不再是将能量以热量形式释放掉。机车通常会采用混合制动方案，
cues.en: system instead of releasing this energy as heat. Locomotives generally use a blended approach

cues.zh: 空气制动与动力制动系统协同配合，精准控制列车的停靠。
cues.en: with both pneumatic and dynamic systems playing a carefully orchestrated role in stopping the train.

cues.zh: 现在，我们前往机车前端，参观车头与驾驶室。
cues.en: Now, let's head to the front of the locomotive for a tour of the nose and operator's cab.

cues.zh: 车头驾驶室有一扇门可供进入。
cues.en: A door at the nose cab allows entry.

cues.zh: 一侧设有一个电子设备柜，里面装有列车前端设备，
cues.en: Off to one side, there's an electronics cabinet with a head of train device which

cues.zh: 与列车尾部设备相配套。还有一个事件记录器、一个分布式动力
cues.en: compliments the end of train device. There's an event recorder, a distributed power

cues.zh: 系统无线模块，可对列车中非直接连接至本务机车的
cues.en: system radio module that gives remote control over locomotives that are a part of the train,

cues.zh: 其他机车进行远程控制。还有一个场站下载无线电，
cues.en: but not directly connected to the lead locomotive. There's a yard download radio which allows

cues.zh: 用于无线下载事件记录器数据，以及一个 GPS 模块。
cues.en: wireless event recorder data downloading, and a GPS module.

cues.zh: 入口通道另一侧是洗手间。
cues.en: At the other side of the entry hallway there's a bathroom.

cues.zh: 旁边还有一个小冰箱。
cues.en: And next to that, a small refrigerator.

cues.zh: 沿楼梯登上驾驶室，可以看到内部照明的开关。
cues.en: Climbing the stairs into the operator's cabin, there are switches for internal lights.

cues.zh: 从车厢后部可以看到驾驶员控制台，
cues.en: From the back of the cabin we can see the operator's console,

cues.zh: 以及另一侧的乘务员控制台。
cues.en: and a crew member's console at the other side.

cues.zh: 我们来近距离看看驾驶员的控制装置。这里有两块智能显示屏，可以显示
cues.en: Let's have a closer look at operator controls. There are two smart displays that can show

cues.zh: 关键系统的详细监控信息，底部还有一排用于操作的按钮。
cues.en: detailed monitoring of critical systems, with rows of buttons at the bottom for interaction.

cues.zh: 下方的警醒按钮属于安全系统，用来确保驾驶员保持警觉。
cues.en: Below that, the alerter button is part of a safety system to ensure driver alertness.

cues.zh: 警醒系统每隔几分钟就会响一次，具体间隔取决于机车速度。如果
cues.en: The alerter system sounds every few minutes or so, depending on locomotive speed. If the

cues.zh: 驾驶员没有在规定的几秒内按下警醒按钮，系统就会自动制动。
cues.en: alerter button is not pressed within a number of seconds, brakes are automatically applied.

cues.zh: 当行驶速度超过 0.5 英里/小时（0.8 千米/小时）时，按下汽笛顺序控制按钮，铃声和汽笛会按预设间隔一起鸣响。
cues.en: The horn sequencer button sounds the bell and horn together at predetermined intervals if

cues.zh: 旁边还有单独的铃声和汽笛按钮。
cues.en: traveling at more than 0.5 mph (0.8 km/h). Individual bell and horn buttons are nearby.

cues.zh: 开关面板集成了各种控制器，比如动力制动开关
cues.en: A switch panel houses various controls, for example the dynamic brake switch

cues.zh: 用来启闭系统。这个开关在领头机车上是打开的，
cues.en: to toggle the system on or off. This switch is on for the lead locomotive,

cues.zh: 但在受领头机车控制的其他机车上是关闭的。
cues.en: but off for other locomotives being controlled by the lead.

cues.zh: 在不同的领头或从动机车配置中，许多其他设置也遵循这种模式。
cues.en: Many other settings follow this pattern in different lead or trailing configurations.

cues.zh: 仪表灯开关负责控制各种操作界面的照明。
cues.en: The gauge light controls lighting for various operator controls.

cues.zh: 呼叫开关可以在从动机车的驾驶室内鸣响警铃。
cues.en: The call switch sounds an alarm bell in the operator cabs of trailing locomotives.

cues.zh: 换向手柄用来控制通电时机车的运行方向。
cues.en: The reverser handle controls which direction the locomotive will move when power is applied.

cues.zh: 机车停放时，该手柄会被取下，
cues.en: This handle is removed when the locomotive is parked,

cues.zh: 跟随领头机车执行“补机”任务时也是如此。
cues.en: or in "helper" duty following a lead locomotive.

cues.zh: 换向手柄具有内置约束限制，以防止受损。
cues.en: The reverser handle has built in constraints to prevent damage.

cues.zh: 在换向手柄离开中间位置之前，
cues.en: The throttle lever above can't be moved from the "idle" position

cues.zh: 上方的油门手柄无法从“怠速”位置移开。
cues.en: until the reverser lever is moved from its center position.

cues.zh: 反之，如果油门设置高于怠速，
cues.en: Conversely, if the throttle is set at more than idle speed,

cues.zh: 换向手柄就无法从前进挡或倒车挡移开。
cues.en: the reverse handle can not be moved from its forward or reverse position.

cues.zh: 如果动车制动没关闭，手柄也会被锁定。
cues.en: The handle is also locked if dynamic braking is not off.

cues.zh: 油门手柄用于控制发动机转速以及输出到车轮的动力。它本质上就是火车的
cues.en: The throttle handle manages engine speed and power output to the wheels. It's essentially the train's

cues.zh: 油门踏板，而在大多数列车运行中，稳定、持续的动力输出设置是最理想的。
cues.en: gas pedal, where a steady, consistent power output setting is ideal for most train operations.

cues.zh: 动车制动手柄用于控制动车制动力。
cues.en: The dynamic braking handle controls dynamic braking force.

cues.zh: 鸣笛、警惕装置和车铃都配有冗余按钮。
cues.en: There are redundant buttons for the horn, alerter, and bell.

cues.zh: 这里还有撒砂系统的控制装置。附近还配有一台双向无线电接收机。
cues.en: There are also controls for the sand system. There's a two-way radio receiver nearby.

cues.zh: 下方的操纵杆用于控制空气制动系统。这里有多种设置，
cues.en: The lever beneath controls the pneumatic brake system. There are various settings

cues.zh: 可用来管理机车本身以及相连车厢的制动系统气压。
cues.en: to manage brake system air pressure, in the locomotive itself and in connected cars.

cues.zh: 下方这个独立制动杆仅控制本机车的空气制动。
cues.en: The independent brake lever below controls air brakes for just this locomotive.

cues.zh: 面板底部有司机室加热器的旋转开关，
cues.en: There are rotating switches at the bottom of the panel for the cab heater,

cues.zh: 以及前照灯和后照灯控制。
cues.en: and also front and rear headlight controls.

cues.zh: 转到后墙，还有一个额外的折叠座椅。
cues.en: Moving to the back wall, there's an additional fold out seat.

cues.zh: 其上方是一组断路器模块和开关。
cues.en: Above that, a grouping of circuit breaker modules and switches.

cues.zh: 中间是一个带防护的发动机控制面板。
cues.en: In the middle, there's a protected engine control panel.

cues.zh: 我们来看看发动机控制开关。
cues.en: Let's look at the engine control switch.

cues.zh: 对于配备该功能的机车，JOG档位可仅靠电池供电移动，
cues.en: For locomotives so equipped, the JOG setting allows movement under battery power alone,

cues.zh: 无需启动发动机。用于短距离移动，比如进出维修车间。
cues.en: without starting the engine. It's used for short distances, like moving in or out of a repair shop.

cues.zh: 选择START后，按下ENGINE START按钮即可启动发动机启动序列。
cues.en: With START selected, the ENGINE START button is pressed to initiate the engine start sequence.

cues.zh: ISOLATE让发动机保持怠速运转，但断开主
cues.en: ISOLATE leaves the engine running at idle but disconnects the main

cues.zh: 发电机以及通往车轮等的动力。RUN档位用于正常运行。
cues.en: generator, and power to the wheels, etc. The RUN setting is for normal operation.

cues.zh: MULTIPLE UNIT 开关可以将多台机车连接起来
cues.en: The MULTIPLE UNIT switch has settings for linking multiple

cues.zh: 并设置不同的组合方式。
cues.en: locomotives together in various configurations.

cues.zh: 这里有发动机启动和停止开关，最后一个控制面板用于控制车头的行人横道灯或
cues.en: There are engine start and stop switches, and the last panel controls crosswalk or

cues.zh: “ditch”灯、车号牌灯，以及其他控制区域的照明。
cues.en: "ditch" lights at the front of the unit, number sign lights, and lighting for other control areas.

cues.zh: AUTO STOP OVERRIDE 按钮可防止发动机在两小时内自动关闭。
cues.en: The AUTO STOP OVERRIDE button prevents the engine from shutting down automatically for two hours.

cues.zh: 现在我们来看看乘务员区域。这里还有一张符合人体工学的
cues.en: Now let's move to the crew member's area. There's an additional ergonomic

cues.zh: 座椅，可用于观察、培训等用途。
cues.en: seat for observing, training, and other purposes.

cues.zh: 乘务员控制台左侧有一块智能显示屏。
cues.en: There's a smart display at the left side of the crew member's console.

cues.zh: 中间的紧急制动阀可启动紧急制动程序。
cues.en: In the center, the emergency brake valve initiates an emergency braking sequence.

cues.zh: 控制台前方有一个喇叭按钮和一个暖气控制开关。
cues.en: At the front of the console there's a horn pushbutton, and a heater control switch.

cues.zh: 朝挡风玻璃方向看，
cues.en: Looking towards the front windshield,

cues.zh: 能看到朝内和朝外的摄像头，用来记录事件。
cues.en: we see inward and outward facing cameras for event recording.
